parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-32 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 184.7 | 18.51 | 18.51
2 | 735.3 | 0.77 | 19.28
3 | 503.9 | 2.27 | 21.55
4 | 56.6 | 33.69 | 55.24
5 | 43.3 | 5.90 | 61.14
6 | 520.0 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KQQH-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-32
Curve type: KQQH
Aquifer depth: 21.55 - 61.14 m
Recommendation: Target the low resistivity zone between 21.55 m and 61.14 m. Ensure appropriate well screening is installed within layers 4 and 5.
